name: What is the process for repairing a concrete slab foundation?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for repairing a concrete slab foundation?

acceptedAnswer.text: The process for repairing a concrete slab foundation typically begins with a thorough inspection to identify the cause and extent of the damage. Depending on the findings, methods may include crack injection with epoxy or polyurethane, mudjacking/slab jacking to lift settled sections using a grout mixture, or piering using steel or concrete piers to provide stable support beneath the foundation. The chosen method aims to stabilize the structure and prevent further settlement.
acceptedAnswer.description: Foundation repair involves inspection, then methods like crack injection, slab jacking to lift settled areas, or piering for structural support.
